title: BLE SenML relay driver
description:
Consume BLE scan data, lookup IPSO mapping, create SenML records, emit to mesh.

**Scope:**
- Accept (MAC, service_uuid, char_uuid, raw_value) tuples from BLE scanner
- Lookup IPSO mapping via gatt_ipso_registry
- Parse raw_value via gatt_value_parser
- Construct SenML record:
  - bn (base name): 'ble:<MAC>/'
  - n (name): '<object_id>/<resource_id>' or IPSO path
  - v (value): parsed physical value
  - u (unit): SenML unit from IPSO mapping
  - t (time): relative timestamp if aggregating
- Aggregate multiple readings within configurable window
- Apply rate limiting (per-device and global)
- Emit SenML pack to configured destination

**CoAP config interface:**
- GET/PUT /config/ble-relay for runtime configuration
- enabled, max_pkt_per_device_min, max_pkt_global_min, aggregation_window_ms, destination

**Dependencies:**
- gatt_ipso_registry (subtask 1)
- gatt_value_parser (subtask 2)
- SenML codec (existing)

**Output:** python/src/lichen/ble/senml_relay.py
